parsed.notes:
Qualifications is a required section; the alternatives introduced by 'especially any of' are individually labeled required, not optional.
LLM experience is explicitly unnecessary and therefore nice_to_have.
Triton denotes the kernel-programming technology, not Triton Inference Server, and has no matching taxonomy entry.
Translating methods between application areas is retained as an unmapped technique rather than assumed to mean transfer learning.
The application domains listed after 'for any domain' are examples of domain experience, not separately requested skills.
Seniority uses the two-year lower bound and the guide's 0–2-year junior range; 'or more' leaves the level ambiguous and is flagged.
Technologies mentioned only in the role description are excluded; generic 'engineering skills' is not assumed to mean software engineering.
